notes: POWO and FNA accept the species.
It is native to Central Asia/China and introduced/naturalized in Texas.

target_zone_range_leads.guardrail: Scout research only. Deep Review must verify exact target-zone counties and resolve any nativity/re-identification conflict.
leads: Master Plant Pool has one personal iNaturalist record.
POWO explicitly lists Texas as introduced.
FNA treats it as introduced/naturalized in North America, including Texas.
Keep only as an ID/comparison weed, excluded from native metrics.

morphology_candidate.look_here_first: Start with the huge soft heart-shaped leaves and fruit: tall annual velvetleaf has broad cordate velvety leaves and a conspicuous wheel/crown-shaped fruit made of many long-beaked mericarps.
diagnostic_traits: large broadly ovate to suborbiculate cordate leaves
many mericarps with divergent 3–6 mm beaks

confusers.separator: Velvetleaf is annual, much larger-leaved, and has a large many-beaked crown-like fruit; A. fruticosum is a gray subshrub with smaller leaves and compact cask-shaped fruit.

photo_candidates.role: flower + developing and mature beaked fruit
